title: Hyprland on a T2 Mac
description: A macOS-style Hyprland desktop for a T2 MacBook Pro on Arch Linux: a Lua config, Python and GTK popups for the bar, and a udev and systemd fix for suspend on Apple's T2 hardware, all installed by one Bash script.
imageAlt: two code windows tiled on the desktop, with the bar's calendar popup open
